fields.name: clientId
fields.description: The order's client, resolved server-side from productionOrders.clientId. Never 1 (walk-in placeholder).

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: The completed production order this call is about. Unique per company: one call per order (idempotency key).

fields.name: callSid
fields.description: Twilio Call SID (CA...). Null until Twilio accepts the call. Unique when present.

fields.name: callStatus
fields.description: Twilio lifecycle, updated by the status callback. Allowed values: queued, ringing, in_progress, completed, no_answer, busy, failed, canceled, skipped. 'skipped' = not dialed (walk-in, no cellphone, opted out, outside the calling window, feature off) -- skipReason says why.

fields.name: skipReason
fields.description: Why the call was not placed: walk_in_client, no_cellphone, opted_out, outside_calling_window, feature_disabled, duplicate_order.

fields.name: endedBy
fields.description: From the LoanAgents CallResult: agent, customer, timeout, error.

fields.name: durationSeconds
fields.description: Talk time reported by Twilio (completed calls).

fields.name: promptVersion
fields.description: Voice secretary prompt version that ran the call (e.g. voice_secretary_v1.5), for tracing an agreement back to the behavior that produced it.

fields.name: identityConfirmed
fields.description: Whether the person on the line clearly confirmed being the customer before any order detail was said (CallResult.identityConfirmed). Defaults to false.

fields.name: agreementRevision
fields.description: Revision number of the LATEST PICKUP_AGREEMENT proposed on the call (the customer may change it mid-call; earlier revisions are superseded). Only this revision can be confirmed.

fields.name: agreementJson
fields.description: The latest PICKUP_AGREEMENT fields as JSON: deliveryMode (pickup|delivery), weekday, date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM), address (delivery only), paymentMethod, notes. Contract: LoanAgents retrieval/contracts.py PICKUP_AGREEMENT. Never the transcript.

fields.name: agreementStatus
fields.description: none (no agreement on the call), invalid (failed server-side validation -> needs staff), pending_confirmation (WhatsApp summary sent, waiting for 'si'), confirmed (customer replied 'si' to the latest revision), cancelled (customer replied 'no'), expired (no reply within the pending TTL).

fields.name: confirmationMessageId
fields.description: Meta wamid of the acuerdo_llamada template sent. A 200 from Meta means accepted, not delivered -- delivery status arrives by webhook (existing whatsappCloud status handling).

fields.name: confirmedAt
fields.description: When the customer's 'si' confirmed the latest revision (UTC).

fields.name: needsStaff
fields.description: True when staff must follow up: the customer asked for a person (REQUEST_HUMAN), the agreement failed validation, or the call ended without one. Drives the POS list filter and the staff push. Defaults to false.

fields.name: staffReason
fields.description: Short reason for needsStaff (REQUEST_HUMAN reason from the agent, or the validation error). No PII.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId -- injected automatically by stored procedures.
FK orderId -> productionOrders.orderId; UNIQUE (companyId, orderId) enforces one call per order.

components.name: VoiceCallsFeedStep
components.description: IonList of calls, newest first: client name, order, callStatus badge, agreementStatus badge (pending_confirmation=amber, confirmed=green, invalid/needsStaff=red), agreed day/time when there is one. IonSegment filter: Todas / Por confirmar / Confirmadas / Requieren atención (needsStaff). Spinner while loading; refetch on view re-enter.

components.name: VoiceCallDetailModal
components.description: IonModal: call timeline (placed, ringing, answered, ended, WhatsApp sent, confirmed), duration, endedBy, identityConfirmed, promptVersion, the agreement fields read as a sentence (e.g. 'Recoge el domingo 8 a las 12:00, pago en efectivo'), agreementRevision, staffReason. Read-only: staff never confirms on the customer's behalf.

endpoints.description: Standard POS GMO upsert/action router over sp_voiceCalls (@pjsonfile), used internally by the connectors below to insert and update rows. Not called by the POS directly.

Worker key (security/worker_key.py). Body: { orderId }. Called by alertDispatcher.notify_cycle_done for companies in VOICE_CALLS_ENABLED_COMPANIES. Resolves the order's company/client/cellphone server-side; applies constraints (a)-(e) and records a 'skipped' row with skipReason instead of dialing when one fails; otherwise mints the call token (payload: companyId, branchId, clientId, orderId, companyName, customerName, order {service, total}; exp <= 15 min) and calls Twilio Calls.create (From=TWILIO_VOICE_CALLER_ID, To=cellphone, Twiml=<Connect><Stream>, StatusCallback=/voiceCalls/twilio-status, StatusCallbackEvent=initiated ringing answered completed) inside timed_integration('twilio_voice', 'place'). Idempotent per (companyId, orderId).

Twilio status callback (form-encoded; validate X-Twilio-Signature with TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN). Updates callStatus/durationSeconds by callSid. On no_answer/busy/failed: no retry loop -- falls back once to the existing order-ready notification (notificationDispatch, eventName order_ready) and sets needsStaff=false.

Worker key. Called by LoanAgents (voice/twilio_bridge.py) when a call ends. Body: { callSid, companyId, clientId, orderId, endedBy, durationS, promptVersion, identityConfirmed, agreement: {capability, revision, fields} | null, requestHuman: {reason} | null }. No transcript. Validates the agreement server-side (constraint g); if valid and identityConfirmed: sends template acuerdo_llamada to the client's WhatsApp ({{1}} companyName, {{2}} first name, {{3}} 'Recoger en sucursal' or 'Entrega a domicilio: <address>', {{4}} date as 'domingo 8 de noviembre', {{5}} time, {{6}} paymentMethod/notes or '-') via whatsappCloud.send_template inside timed_integration('whatsapp_cloud', 'acuerdo_llamada'); stores it with whatsappChannels.set_pending(channel, phone, {capability: 'PICKUP_AGREEMENT', voiceCallId, revision}, ttl 24 h) and sets agreementStatus=pending_confirmation. requestHuman -> needsStaff=true + staff push. log_audit on every agreementStatus change.

Internal, called from whatsappReservations.reply_to when the WhatsApp pending proposal has capability PICKUP_AGREEMENT (instead of _book): Body { voiceCallId, revision, decision: confirm|cancel }. confirm -> only if revision == the row's agreementRevision and agreementStatus == pending_confirmation (else reject and re-send the latest summary); sets confirmed + confirmedAt, push to staff ('Gilberto confirmó: recoge domingo 8, 12:00'), and the WhatsApp reply '¡Listo! Te esperamos el <día> a las <hora>.' cancel -> cancelled + needsStaff=true. Integration point: whatsappReservations.reply_to must branch on the pending capability (today it assumes CREATE_RESERVATION).
List for the POS page: { companyId, filter: all|pending|confirmed|needsStaff, limit } -> rows joined with clients.first_name/last_name. Never returns the client's phone.
Detail for the modal: { companyId, voiceCallId }.
